pencereler.0-5: A mine is a hole holding up an entire mountain. The rock above weighs
pencereler.5-12: millions of tons and wants to fall. Miners leave pillars of rock behind to hold up the roof. But
pencereler.12-20: take out too much, and those pillars slowly crush. Water seeping in weakens the rock and rusts the supports. A single failing
pencereler.20-30: pillar can start a chain collapse. Then there is gas - a spark in a coal mine is catastrophic. Modern mines use sensors to catch the rock groaning
